title: Cricbet99 Account Blocked?
subtitle: Immediate assistance for restricted accounts. Learn why blocks happen and how to restore your full trading access through WhatsApp.
intro: Having your account restricted can be stressful, but it's usually a temporary security measure designed to protect your balance. This guide walks you through the common reasons for an account block and how to get back online immediately.

At Cricbet99, we take security seriously. If our system detects unusual login patterns or unverified activity, we may temporarily lock the ID until a real human can verify your identity. This is part of our commitment to being India's safest betting platform.

Restoring your account is simple. By contacting our 24/7 WhatsApp support and completing a quick identity verification, you can usually have your block removed and your full balance restored in minutes.

faqs.q: Why was my account blocked suddenly?
faqs.a: It's usually a proactive security measure due to a login attempt from a new location or a need for updated KYC information.

faqs.q: Will I lose my balance if blocked?
faqs.a: Absolutely not. Your funds are held securely. Once your access is restored, your entire balance will be exactly as you left it.
Most accounts are unblocked within 5 to 10 minutes of contacting our WhatsApp support and providing the required verification.

faqs.q: How can I prevent future blocks?
faqs.a: Avoid using VPNs, don't share your login details, and ensure your registered mobile number is always accessible for OTPs.
